name: @tty-pt/jarvis
description: Multilingual Voice Assistant Ontology, Adaptive VAD, Wake-Word Matching, and Streaming TTS Segmentation

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node -I../include native/jarvis_napi.c -L../lib -Wl,-rpath,'$ORIGIN/../../../lib' -Wl,-rpath,'$HOME/.local/lib' -ljarvis -lm -o build/Release/jarvis_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: Paulo Quirino <quirinpa@gmail.com>
